parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for non-small cell lung carcinoma. Join drug_indication to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Filter where mesh_heading equals 'non-small cell lung carcinoma' and max_phase_for_ind is 4. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
